Name: Hebron, Son of Mareshah
Summary: Son of Mareshah and father of Korah, Tappuah, Rekem, and Shema.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 2:43: Son of Mareshah and father of Korah, Tappuah, Rekem, and Shema.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Hebron stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
